note: Hardware already on the surface (landers and impact sites) and planned missions near the south pole. Planned targets are region-level unless an exact point is public. For live, operator-submitted data see the Open Lunar Foundation Lunar Ledger.

items.name: Chandrayaan-1 Moon Impact Probe
items.note: India’s impact probe; crashed on the Earth-facing slope of Connecting Ridge (refined location from LROC images).

items.name: LCROSS Centaur stage
items.note: NASA’s spent Centaur upper stage, crashed into permanently shadowed Cabeus crater to search for water.

items.name: LCROSS shepherding spacecraft
items.note: Followed the Centaur into Cabeus four minutes later.

items.name: IM-1 Odysseus lander
items.note: Intuitive Machines; lying on its side near Malapert A.

items.name: IM-2 Athena lander
items.note: Intuitive Machines; landed about 250 m from its target on Mons Mouton and tipped over.

items.name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander and Pragyan rover
items.note: ISRO; outside the polar region shown in 3D.

items.name: Chang’e-7 (China)
items.note: Lander, rover and hopper expected to target the Shackleton crater rim; the official landing point has not been published.

items.name: Blue Moon MK1 pathfinder (Blue Origin)
items.note: Reported target: Shackleton Connecting Ridge. Landing not confirmed at the time of our check.

items.name: Griffin Mission One (Astrobotic)
items.note: NASA CLPS delivery to the Nobile crater region.

items.name: Artemis crewed landing (NASA)
items.note: One of the 9 candidate regions (Haworth, Malapert Massif, Mons Mouton Plateau, Mons Mouton, Nobile Rim 1 and 2, de Gerlache Rim 2, Peak near Cabeus B, Slater Plain).
